name: unifi
summary: UniFi Site Manager API (hosted): read hosts, sites and devices; any change asks first
notes: This is UniFi's hosted Site Manager API over HTTPS: it reaches your consoles through your UI account, not your LAN, so a controller on a private address with a self-signed certificate is NOT reached by this template: use the unifi-controller template for that.
The secret is an API key made in your UniFi account (unifi.ui.com, API section); it is sent in the X-API-Key header. It is a reference to the store, never in this file.
Reads: GET /v1/hosts, GET /v1/sites, GET /v1/devices. Every POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE asks first.
